Rowan (Partnerships): Hey team, starting the marketplace onboarding for Pilot B. Need to align on SKU breakdown, publisher roles, and legal artifacts. Quick sync?
Kaya (Cloud Eng): I can own publisher roles and the AMI/container checks. Which SKUs are we exposing?
Arjun (Product): Two SKUs please: redwood-hosted-metered and redwood-dedicated-commit. Include a feature line about private VPC options for enterprise customers.
Marta (Legal): For listings we need EULA, a short DPA, and a statement about data residency. If Azure is constrained to EU regions, note that explicitly.
Faye (Marketing): I'll prepare two short blurbs (120 words each), screenshots, and a one-line tagline. Need SVG logo and an architecture diagram (PNG).
marketplace-bot: Reminder: Intake form due in 72 hours -> https://internal/marketplace/intake
Rowan (Partnerships): I'll gather publisher IDs and billing contacts. AWS/GCP regions: us-east-1 and europe-west1. Azure: confirm with partner.
Kaya (Cloud Eng): For IAM, recommend roles: publisher-admin (upload/listing), publisher-billing (billing read), publisher-support (logs access). I'll draft Terraform + ARM samples.
Arjun (Product): We should surface p95 latency range and an estimated tokens/second metric. Kaya can pull staging perf numbers?
Kaya (Cloud Eng): Yep, Ian run a quick perf job and export p95 by EOD tomorrow.
Marta (Legal): Marketing language: avoid definitive SLA claims unless we commit contractual SLAs. Use "engineered for high availability" instead. Also need partner's logo usage permission.
Faye (Marketing): Noted. I'll avoid absolutes. Will request logo usage and collect high-res assets.
Rowan (Partnerships): Action items:
- Kaya: IAM templates + staging p95 export (due +24h)
- Marta: EULA + DPA draft (due +48h)
- Faye: blurbs + assets collection (due +48h)
- Arjun: list of supported models and sample curl example (due +36h)
- Rowan: submit intake and confirm Azure region with partner (due +24h)
Kaya (Cloud Eng): Starting templates now, will post snippets here.
Arjun (Product): I'll draft the curl/node examples and model list.
Marta (Legal): I'll DM partner for trademark and logo permission and circulate redlines.
Rowan (Partnerships): Great. I'll update the tracker and loop in the partner once we have drafts. :shipit:
